name: lra-benchmarks
description: The Long Range Arena (LRA) benchmark is a suite of tasks designed to evaluate models' ability to handle very long-context dependencies. It includes diverse tasks (e.g., long-sequence classification, retrieval, and algorithmic tasks) that require modeling relationships over thousands of tokens. LRA is used to compare attention mechanisms and long-range sequence models by reporting per-task and aggregated performance.
reputation: Widely used in research on long-range sequence modeling and efficient attention mechanisms.
